name: FTAM Classic: Origins
author: redstonecharger@gmail.com
description: Minecraft 1.7.10 Forge modpack server. Each start updates to the pack's latest GitHub release (the one the Technic pack uses), or to the release set in Pack release.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Runs once in Pterodactyl's installer container (as root, server files at /mnt/server).
# Clones the pack and puts its start script in place; the first start installs Forge, mods and settings.
# Reinstalling keeps the world and configs, and only refreshes the pack and start.sh.
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates > /dev/null
cd /mnt/server
if [ -d pack/.git ]; then
    git -C pack fetch -q --tags --force origin
else
    rm -rf pack
    git clone -q https://github.com/iRedSC/FTAM-Classic-Origins.git pack
fi
git -C pack show origin/main:pterodactyl/start.sh > start.sh
echo "Installed. Start the server to download Forge and the pack's latest release."

variables.name: Pack release
variables.description: latest follows the newest release on every start. A tag such as curseforge-dev-9e0abdc pins that release, for example to roll back; set it back to latest to follow again. Tags: https://github.com/iRedSC/FTAM-Classic-Origins/releases
